item.description: On this episode of Four More Pages, Mya Clark sits down with Dr. Timothy Bowman.

item.title: Amarillo Zoo closed Saturday, Jan. 31
item.description: The Amarillo Zoo announced that it will be closed this Saturday, Jan. 31, due to low temperatures.

item.title: Changes take place at Guyon Saunders Resource Center
item.description: At the end of last year, it was announced that Guyon Saunders Resource Center would cease operations.

item.title: Potter County man arrested on multiple counts of child sexual abuse
item.description: According to a complaint filed in Potter County, a Potter County man was arrested on multiple counts related to child sexual assault.

item.title: Former 'person of interest' in Ysasaga case pleads guilty to federal meth charge
item.description: Christian Castro, a former person of interest in the Mark Ysasaga case, was sentenced to 12 years and 4 months in federal prison on an unrelated narcotics trafficking charge, while Jose Simental was served with a warrant for Ysasaga's murder and later pleaded guilty to Tampering with Evidence, receiving a 7 year sentence.

item.title: 2026 Amarillo Sod Poodles promotional schedule
item.description: The Amarillo Sod Poodles released its 2026 promotional schedule for its seventh season, featuring giveaways, fireworks, drone shows, and themed nights.

item.title: City of Borger votes to withdraw from PASE
item.description: The City of Borger announced that its City Council voted during its regular meeting on Jan. 20 to withdraw from the Interlocal Agreement to Form the Panhandle Alliance for Safe Electricity (PASE).

item.title: Underwood Law Firm appoints first female president
item.description: Officials with the Underwood Law Firm announced that it has hired the firm's first female president, marking a historic milestone in the firm’s 114-year history.

item.title: 2nd person accused of accepting shipment of liquid methamphetamine at Hereford home sentenced
item.description: A second person who was accused of accepting a shipment of liquid methamphetamine at a home in Hereford was sentenced.
